title: Momentum (ভরবেগ)
placement: Book pages 71–72, topic 3.4: ভরবেগ (Momentum). Next to the truck-and-bicycle paragraph, p⃗ = mv⃗ and the box with the unit kg m/s and the dimension MLT⁻¹.
description: Momentum (ভরবেগ, page 71, 3.4) as the book's thought experiment, run by the student: a loaded truck (10,000 kg) and a bicycle with its rider (80 kg) go at the same velocity along a town street lined with shops toward two parked small cars, which are in view from the start. Over each a blue arrow shows its velocity v (equally long on the screen for both) and a green arrow its momentum p = m v, both p arrows on one scale: the bicycle's is short, the truck's, 125 times as long, runs off the screen, with its label at the edge. The panel shows p = m v with the numbers for both (kg m/s, Bangladeshi commas) and the book's box (unit kg m/s, dimension [p] = MLT⁻¹). A tap on the truck (or চালাও) plays the run in real time: the truck crumples its car and shoves it about 2 m (brake lights on), the bicycle moves its car about a centimetre; from then on the table says it is the momentum at the moment of the hit. The velocity stepper (1–8 m/s) and উল্টো দিকে show both factors and the vector (to the left is negative). Test tab: 5 questions on their own pictures with every mass on screen (which does more damage and why, p of a body read off the picture, a slow heavy body against a fast light one, the velocity doubled, the sign of p moving left). Phone-first, Bangla.
